leaseHandoffReview.behavior: After reading saved state and validating its plan hash, a POD continuation with a finite future saved controller lease expiry returns waiting/controller_lease_pending with wakeAt equal to that expiry plus one second. This branch precedes plan, claim, cancel and drive operations; a resumed durable step keeps its new random lease token rather than reusing the old process token.
leaseHandoffReview.boundary: No source, recipient, model, data category, price ceiling, pass/call/receipt limit, deadline, migration or owner permission is expanded. Waiting does not authorize transport replay or renew dispatch time.
leaseHandoffReview.verification: Independent current-source static inspection and exact byte-pin verification only. The implementation owner reported a hosted-CI lease handoff defect and is adding regression coverage; this addendum does not claim the new real-server regression, Next sleep/resume fixture or hosted rerun has completed.

retentionSemantics.application: Bounded refers to retained content volume and purpose, not automatic deletion at source/template/run expiry. Saved evidence and receipts persist for audit.
retentionSemantics.inference: Requests require data_collection=deny, zdr=true, one exact endpoint, no fallback and verified route receipts. This is endpoint routing policy, not a guarantee that no transient cache ever exists.
retentionSemantics.router: OpenRouter documents no prompt retention unless logging is opted in. This review did not inspect current account logging settings; do not claim such settings were checked.
retentionSemantics.search: Exa query retention and improvement/training are possible. No mediated-account ZDR exception is established; no personal data should be included.

reviewNature: Independent read-only engineering and documented-use review; no owner approval, publisher licence, production activation or paid-run authority.
